origin.description: Add the elements of a numeric vector with the demo signals off unless the caller turns one on.
origin.usage: slow_sum(x, delay = getOption("progressr.demo.delay", 1.0), stdout = FALSE, message = FALSE, sticky = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector to sum. An integer vector keeps integer storage.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.text: Seconds passed to slow_sum_p. The default reads progressr.demo.delay, or 1.0 when that option is unset.

arguments.name: stdout
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is FALSE, so the hidden slow_sum_p option is not read.

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is FALSE.

arguments.name: sticky
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is FALSE.

arguments.name: progress
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is FALSE.

origin.details: Calls slow_sum_p with the same delay. stdout, message, sticky, and progress are explicit, so an omitted argument here is FALSE and does not consult progressr.slow_sum_p.*.

translation.description: Add the elements of a numeric vector with the demo signals off unless the caller turns one on.
translation.usage: slow_sum(x, delay=<omitted>, stdout=False, message=False, sticky=False, progress=False)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector to sum. A vector of ints keeps a Python int.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.text: Seconds passed to slow_sum_p. Omitted reads progressr.demo.delay, or 1.0 when that option is unset.

arguments.name: stdout
arguments.text: Passed through. The default False is explicit, so the hidden slow_sum_p option is not read.

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is False.

arguments.name: sticky
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is False.

arguments.name: progress
arguments.text: Passed through. The default is False.

translation.details: Calls slow_sum_p with the same delay. The four flags are real False values, so progressr.slow_sum_p.* is not consulted.
translation.example:
from progressr.demo import slow_sum
print(f"slow_sum(1:10) returns {slow_sum(list(range(1, 11)), delay=0)}.")
